text: Code refactoring is the process of improving the structure of existing code without changing what it does. Developers often clean up messy code to make it easier to read and understand. This is important because readable code helps teams work faster and make fewer mistakes. Refactoring also reduces technical debt, which builds up when quick fixes are used instead of proper solutions. By regularly improving code structure, teams keep their projects healthy and easier to maintain over time. Good refactoring makes software simpler and more reliable for everyone.
